integrity: The numerical and group-character evidence consists of reconstructed finite integer chain data, a checked integer cycle/cocycle pairing, exact modular rank lower bounds with proved rational upper bounds, and 240 signed chain traces. The included script checks the embedded certificate.
scientific_limitations: A rational equivariant theorem for the five-crown matching complex only; no uniform crown-graph theorem, integral equivariant lattice splitting, or equivariant homotopy classification is claimed. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent specialist review.
title: Full \(S_5\times C_2\) homology characters of the five-crown matching complex
